You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was British and French resistance as a factor in the failure of the Schlieffen Plan?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the machine gun as a cause of the stalemate on the Western Front? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was the occupation of the Ruhr amongst the social and economic problems in
Weimar Germany, 1919–24? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Second World War in determining Nazi policies towards the Jews? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was the 1905 Revolution in weakening the Tsarist system of government to 1914?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were policies towards women amongst the social changes in Stalin’s Russia after
1928? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the loss of foreign markets as a reason why US agriculture did not prosper in
the 1920s? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Red Scare as an aspect of intolerance in US society in the 1920s? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the Second World War in the rivalry between the Nationalist government and
the Chinese Communist Party? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Great Leap Forward in Mao's modernisation of China? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was economic growth in shaping the lives of South Africans before 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant in the resistance to apartheid was the South African Students' Organisation (SASO)?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was President Nasser as a cause of the Suez War in 1956? Explain your answer.
How significant were Palestinian militants as a factor shaping the Palestinian peace process?
Explain your answer. [40]
